description: This file defines the Waiter class for AWS SDK, which implements polling mechanisms for AWS resources, encapsulating logic for asynchronous wait operations using promises. It includes configurations, state determination, and a coroutine-based promise method.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: Represents a resource waiter that polls an AWS resource until a specific state is reached, utilizing promises for asynchronous operation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Waiter with a client, name, command arguments, and configuration, validating required fields and callables.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the waiter reaches a success state or rejects upon failure, employing a coroutine.

methods.name: getArgsForAttempt
methods.description: Generates and returns the command arguments for a specific attempt, including delay handling.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Determines the current state of the waiter ('success', 'failed', 'retry') based on the result of polling.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if the result matches a specific path based on the acceptor configuration.

methods.name: matchesPathAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements in the result match expected values for a given path.

methods.name: matchesPathAny
methods.description: Checks if any element in the result matches the expected value for a given path.

methods.name: matchesStatus
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP status code or response status matches the acceptor's expected status.

methods.name: matchesError
methods.description: Checks if the result matches the expected error conditions, such as specific error codes or connection errors.
